nodes.name: Read state.json
nodes.notes: state.json is 136 bytes, so the JSON envelope returns its content and blob sha intact.

nodes.name: Read issues.ndjson sha
nodes.notes: Metadata only. The blob sha is required by the PUT and changes on every write, so it is re-fetched every run and never cached. The content field of this response is EMPTY (the file is over 1 MB) and must not be used — "Read issues.ndjson" fetches the bytes.

nodes.name: Read issues.ndjson
nodes.notes: Accept: application/vnd.github.raw is mandatory. With the default JSON media type the Contents API returns HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content field for files over 1 MB, and issues.ndjson is 2.86 MB. Measured 2026-09-06.

nodes.name: Fetch issues
nodes.notes: The Code node sandbox has no network access, so all GitHub HTTP happens here. Paging is the node's built-in cursor pagination over the GraphQL endCursor.

nodes.name: Write state.json
nodes.notes: Runs AFTER the store write, deliberately. If the store write fails the watermark is not advanced and the next run re-fetches the same window; the reverse order would leave a permanent gap.
